summary: Fix confirmed. At c2ec220c83d4 and the fix parent 91c7cc41881c, one process calling exl3_gemm on cuda:0 and then the same kernel on cuda:1 completed the cuda:0 call and died inside the cuda:1 call: 'GPU assert: too many blocks in cooperative launch ... exl3_gemm.cu 135', exit code 208 (cudaErrorCooperativeLaunchTooLarge, 720 mod 256), consistent with the 90 KB dynamic shared-memory attribute never being set on the second device. cuda:0-only and cuda:1-only controls succeeded at both commits. At the fix dc69b16752a9 both calls completed and the cuda:1 output equalled the cuda:1-only control exactly.
what_ran: repro.py, with physical GPUs 0 and 1 visible (user approval for this test), runs three child processes that call the extension's exl3_gemm binding on identical CPU-seeded K=4 EXL3 buffers (1x2048x2048, automatic selection picked shape 2), printing a marker before and after each call: test = cuda:0 then cuda:1; controls = cuda:1 only and cuda:0 only.
limits: exl3_gemm only; exl3_mgemm, which shares the cache, was not exercised. Random buffer contents (launch behaviour and determinism only, not numerical correctness). Two identical RTX 3090s. The extension for tree c9456158 (fix parent) was built once in another commit's worktree with the same tree hash, so its error message shows that path.
